name: Holy Land
style_block: Rough unfinished watercolor; heavy pigment, broken washes, blooms, searching pencil, raw paper.
lighting: Natural sun and soft shade. Rough paper supplies the brightest light.

background.composition: A clear place and road, low limestone buildings, olive terraces, open room for characters.
background.identity_policy: Use the authored place. Use period-grounded materials and buildings.
background.sample_prompt:
B43L. Rough unfinished watercolor; heavy pigment, broken washes, blooms, searching pencil, raw paper.
Bethlehem, Town of the Nativity, already mid-journey. Low flat-roofed limestone homes gather along a Judean ridge; silver olive leaves shade empty courtyard lanes in the evening wind.

avatar.composition: A single clear person already mid-journey, useful object in hand, room around the figure.
avatar.identity_policy: Use the authored role and the approved face, clothes and personal objects. Peter's linen and wool are proposed visual details.
avatar.sample_prompt:
B43L. Rough unfinished watercolor; heavy pigment, broken washes, blooms, searching pencil, raw paper.
Simon Peter, Fisherman Learning Steadiness, already mid-journey. A Galilean fisherman in a linen tunic and wool mantle holds mended flax net cord beside his boat, ready to help.

purpose: Reusable art direction for future backgrounds and avatars; review edition.
